reels.title: ScholarCatalyst: A Benchmark for Retrieving Papers That Inspire New Research

editorial_notes.reasoning: This paper addresses a universal curiosity regarding how AI can search the 'library of human knowledge'. It fits the high-performing hardware_efficiency category and allows for a compelling, library-based visual analogy.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: Why do the smartest scientists know exactly which buried paper holds the key to their discovery?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A magical, self-organizing library where books pull themselves off the shelf when you have a specific problem.
